Common Gotchas

  • Degrees vs. radians. sin(30°) = 0.5, but sin(30 radians) = -0.9880. Check the mode before using trig functions.
  • Order of operations. 2 + 3 × 4 = 14, not 20. Use parentheses to group, for example (2 + 3) × 4 = 20.
  • log vs. ln. log is base 10 and ln is base e. log(1000) = 3, ln(e) = 1.

extra_faqs.q: What does the factorial button do?
extra_faqs.a: n! multiplies all whole numbers from 1 to n. For example, 5! = 120.

extra_faqs.q: How do I calculate a square root?
extra_faqs.a: Use the √ key, or raise the number to the power 0.5.

extra_faqs.q: Why does my trig result look wrong?
extra_faqs.a: The calculator may be in radians when you expect degrees. Switch the mode and try again.
